dialog.shortcuts.text:
Space: play / stop · Ctrl+Space: from the cursor · L: pattern or song
F5 playlist · F6 steps · F7 piano roll · F8 explorer · F9 mixer · F10 tracker · F12 screenshot
Ctrl+N new · Ctrl+O open · Ctrl+S save · Ctrl+Shift+S save as · Ctrl+Q quit
Ctrl+Z undo · Ctrl+Y redo

Piano keys (every view): Z S X D C V G B H N J M and Q 2 W 3 E R 5 T 6 Y 7 U I 9 O 0 P. Keypad +/-: octave.

Tracker: arrows, Tab, PageUp/PageDown, Home/End move the cursor. With ● (record) the keys write notes, 1 writes off and Delete clears. Dragging with the mouse selects; Ctrl+C/X/V copy, cut and paste; Ctrl+A all; Shift+Up/Down semitone; Ctrl+Up/Down octave.

Steps: click sets or clears, drag paints, right-click: volume and off. Piano roll: drag draws, moves or stretches; right-click erases. Ctrl+wheel: zoom.
